Redesign review

What’s ready to review

The six-section structure remains: Home, About Us, Consulting, Solutions, Virtualizations, and Contact us. The Virtualizations section still presents the original voice, VoIP, and training offering.

Before a client launch

  • Original brand asset: the uploaded logo informed this proposed flat wordmark and antenna treatment. It keeps the name, blue palette, and radio-tower concept; client approval is needed for adoption.
  • Imagery: the supplied legacy images informed a new coherent set of AI-generated service visuals. People and facilities are illustrative, not Mafaza staff or premises.
  • Office details: the indexed Contact page lists Guelph, while the older About page lists Toronto. Guelph is used for contact; confirm current Canadian and regional office information.
  • Consulting copy: the supplied homepage confirms network audits, technology business cases, vendor evaluation, and the transformation lifecycle. Explanations have been rewritten for readability.
  • Content currency: the accessible service and About snapshots are older. Confirm the service offering and team experience with the client.
  • Contact flow: this prototype prepares an email draft locally. A visitor chooses whether to open and send it.
